divergences.description: ApiClient.call() gained a second new parameter, `unwrapData`, which returns the full decoded body without validating it. This was needed because `entries-list` returns `data` as an array. The plan (research.md R1, T001) describes only a `queryParameters` addition and says existing behaviour is otherwise unchanged. Nothing in the plan mentions this extra change to the shared HTTP wrapper.

T023 says RecordsPage dispatches `RecordsStarted` once in initState. T024 also has the route builder dispatch it. The plan asks for both, which contradicts itself. The implementation dispatches only from the route builder and leaves it out of the page's initState.

T023 plans a `ListView` with one date-heading row per group. The implementation instead uses a CustomScrollView with SliverMainAxisGroup and pinned SliverPersistentHeader date headings. This adds sticky-header scrolling behaviour that neither the plan nor the spec describes.

The plan says zero visual values may be hardcoded outside design_tokens.dart (Principle IV/RNF08). The new widgets still hardcode some sizes: a 4px card spine width, a 40x40 funnel button and a 32px date-header height.

divergences.description: ApiClient.call() gained a second new parameter, `unwrapData` (default true). When it is false, the method skips the inner 'data' unwrapping and Map validation and returns the raw body. The plan (T001, research.md R1) allowed only one addition to ApiClient: the `queryParameters` passthrough. The extra parameter exists because the existing ApiClient rejects a non-Map 'data' payload, and the entries-list response has an array there, a repository fact the plan did not account for. The plan does not mention this change.

T023 says RecordsPage dispatches RecordsStarted once in initState. In the diff, only the route builder dispatches it (T024), and RecordsPage deliberately does not, to avoid fetching the first page twice. The plan's T023 and T024 each told a different place to dispatch the same event.

The plan (T023) asked for a plain ListView with one date-heading row per DateGroup. The diff uses a CustomScrollView with SliverMainAxisGroup and pinned SliverPersistentHeader date headings, so each heading sticks to the top while its group scrolls underneath. That sticky-header behavior is not in the plan.

divergences.description: ApiClient.call() gained an extra `unwrapData` parameter (returns the full body instead of unwrapping/validating the inner 'data' object), which the plan never specified; T001 only adds `queryParameters`. Needed because the existing ApiClient rejects non-object 'data' payloads, which doesn't fit the array-shaped entries-list response.

T023 says RecordsPage dispatches RecordsStarted once in initState, while T024 has the route builder dispatch it. The plan contradicts itself; the implementation dispatches only from the route builder and not from the page.

T023 specifies a ListView with one date-heading row per group. The implementation uses a CustomScrollView whose date headings stay pinned while their group scrolls (SliverMainAxisGroup + pinned SliverPersistentHeader), a scroll behavior the plan doesn't include.

The spec edge case says a newest page that is empty while older entries exist must keep paging and must not show the empty state, which is reserved for true zero-entry accounts. The page shows RecordsEmptyState whenever the loaded list is empty, without checking nextCursor. No scrollable list is built in that case, so further pages are never requested.
